content.name: Gem of Seeing
entries: This gem has 3 charges. As an action, you can speak the gem's command word and expend 1 charge. For the next 10 minutes, you have {@sense truesight} out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.
The gem regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.
